patch_description: This ansatz improves on the previous designs by implementing a mixed rotation axis strategy. Instead of using only RY gates in the input layer, I alternate between RY and RZ rotations on different qubits. This diversifies the input-axis pool while maintaining the same parameter count (16 per block). The alternating approach allows the circuit to explore feature correlations along different rotational axes, potentially capturing more complex patterns in the data. The entanglement structure uses two layers of CZ gates in a ring topology for better qubit connectivity. I've also added a final RZ layer for output shaping. This design maintains a good balance between parameter efficiency (16 parameters per block) and expressivity while reducing the gate count compared to the previous version, which should lead to faster training convergence.
